name: dose_weight_based
description: Weight- or BSA-based dose arithmetic (amount per kg or per m2, per dose or per day split by frequency) with a hard maximum single dose that the input must give, an optional maximum daily dose, rounding to a given increment, and conversion to a volume from a concentration. Exact fractions; flags every cap and rounding. It never suggests a dose, and every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice, verify with a clinician or pharmacist.

dose.description: Amount per kg or per m2, from the prescription

max_dose.description: Hard maximum single dose in dose_unit (required)

rounding_increment.description: Dose rounded to a multiple of this

volume_increment.description: mL; the measured volume never exceeds the dose

catalog.source: Standard dosage-calculation arithmetic: dose = amount per kg (or m2) x weight (or BSA); volume = desired / have x quantity (the D/H x Q formula of nursing and pharmacy dosage texts)
